hooks.command: [ -n "$TMUX_PANE" ] || exit 0; jq -r '.message // ""' | grep -qi permission && tmux set -w -t "$TMUX_PANE" @claude red 2>/dev/null || true
[ -n "$TMUX_PANE" ] || exit 0; [ "$(tmux show -wv -t "$TMUX_PANE" @claude 2>/dev/null)" = red ] || tmux set -w -t "$TMUX_PANE" @claude green 2>/dev/null || true
[ -n "$TMUX_PANE" ] || exit 0; [ "$(tmux show -wv -t "$TMUX_PANE" @claude 2>/dev/null)" = red ] && tmux set -w -t "$TMUX_PANE" -u @claude 2>/dev/null || true
